personas.name: Darlene Okafor
personas.occupation: Part-time eBay reseller (thrifted clothing & shoes), retired school admin
personas.current_solution: Takes photos against a white bedsheet; occasionally pays a grandkid to 'clean them up' in some app
personas.motivation: eBay listings with messy backgrounds sell worse; heard white backgrounds matter
personas.patience: low — if it's confusing in a minute she closes the tab

personas.name: Marcus Tran
personas.occupation: Full-time Poshmark/Depop seller, ~80 listings a week
personas.current_solution: Photoroom free tier on phone (hates the watermark prompts), Canva when on laptop
personas.motivation: Volume — anything that shaves seconds per listing matters; sick of Photoroom upsells
personas.patience: medium — will tolerate a one-time setup cost if throughput is good after

personas.name: Rita Vasquez
personas.current_solution: remove.bg free (annoyed by the resolution cap), then Canva to put on white and resize to 2000px
personas.motivation: Etsy thumbnails need clean white backgrounds at 2000x2000; her current flow is 3 tools

personas.name: Kevin Doyle
personas.occupation: Software engineer, sells old electronics on eBay a few times a year
personas.current_solution: GIMP by hand, or just ships photos with cluttered desk backgrounds
personas.motivation: Skeptical of 'free' web tools that secretly upload images; privacy claim caught his eye
personas.patience: high — will open devtools to check the privacy claim

personas.name: Amara Singh
personas.current_solution: Photoroom app free tier; sometimes just crops tight and hopes
personas.motivation: Wants the white-background look the big sellers have, on her phone, free
personas.patience: low — mobile attention span; a 20-second unexplained spinner loses her

personas.name: Tom Brzezinski
personas.occupation: Sells woodworking pieces at craft fairs; daughter set up an Etsy shop for him
personas.current_solution: Daughter edits photos when she visits; otherwise uploads as-is
personas.motivation: Wants to stop waiting for his daughter to make listings look professional
personas.patience: medium — patient by nature but easily lost by jargon like 'PNG' or 'transparent'

personas.name: Jess Nakamura
personas.current_solution: Photoshop 'Select Subject' — professional quality in 30 seconds
personas.motivation: Evaluating free tools to recommend to small-business clients who won't pay for Photoshop
personas.patience: high, but judges output quality harshly (hair edges, fine detail, halos)
personas.relationship_to_problem: adjacent skeptic — has a better paid tool

personas.name: Priya Patel
personas.occupation: Runs a small Shopify store for phone accessories; also lists on eBay
personas.current_solution: Pays a Fiverr freelancer $15 per batch of 20 product photos, 2-day turnaround
personas.motivation: Cost and turnaround — wants same-day listings without the Fiverr loop
personas.patience: medium — compares everything to 'is this better than waiting 2 days'

personas.name: Caleb Wright
personas.occupation: College student flipping sneakers on StockX/eBay
personas.current_solution: Doesn't edit — shoots on his dorm floor; thinks editing tools are for 'serious sellers'
personas.motivation: Saw a TikTok about white-background listings selling faster; mildly curious
personas.patience: very low — three taps or he's gone
personas.relationship_to_problem: adjacent skeptic — doesn't believe he needs this

personas.name: Helen Marsh
personas.occupation: Office manager; sells household items on Facebook Marketplace when decluttering
personas.current_solution: Nothing — posts photos straight from her camera roll
personas.motivation: A friend said her couch listing photo 'looked like a crime scene'; wants nicer photos with zero learning curve
personas.patience: low-medium — will follow obvious instructions but won't hunt for features
personas.relationship_to_problem: adjacent — Facebook Marketplace doesn't require white backgrounds
